findings.title: SQL injection in todo search
findings.attacker_view: Anyone logged in can send q = %' OR '1'='1 and read every user's todos, or worse, change the query.
findings.fix: Use a placeholder: db.prepare("... AND title LIKE ?").all(req.userId, `%${q}%`).

findings.title: Hard-coded fallback JWT secret
findings.attacker_view: If JWT_SECRET is not set, anyone who reads the code can sign their own tokens and log in as any user.
findings.fix: Refuse to start when JWT_SECRET is missing instead of falling back to a fixed string.

findings.title: CORS open to every site
findings.attacker_view: Any website can call the API from a visitor's browser.
findings.fix: Set origin to the client's URL only.

findings.title: HTML injection in the todo list
findings.attacker_view: A todo titled with an tag runs script in the browser.
findings.fix: Render {todo.title} as text instead of dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

findings.title: A file that does not exist
No rate limit on login
findings.attacker_view: Someone can try thousands of passwords a minute.
